observations.observation: Does the current ensemble use all five folds?
observations.evidence: current_code.py: FOLDS = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], followed by a mean across the fold predictions.

observations.observation: Does the current pipeline resize test images to 448 by 448?
observations.evidence: current_code.py: IMAGE_SIZE = (448, 448) is passed to resize_images before inference.

observations.observation: Does the existing inference loop use test-time augmentation?
observations.evidence: current_code.py, run_inference_loop: one model(x.to(device)) call per batch, followed directly by sigmoid and collection.

observations.observation: Do any target names encode left versus right laterality?
observations.evidence: current_code.py, CLASSES: all 11 targets describe tube placement categories or Swan Ganz presence, with no left/right target.

observations.observation: Does the current code set the model to evaluation mode?
observations.evidence: current_code.py, run_inference_loop calls model.eval() before inference; head dropout is therefore disabled.

observations.observation: Are the normalization constants currently represented as strings?
observations.evidence: current_code.py, get_dataloaders_for_inference: mean and std are single-element lists containing quoted numeric strings.

observations.observation: Does the enabled rank postprocessing produce values bounded by one?
observations.evidence: current_code.py: two argsort calls produce zero-based integer ranks across test rows; those ranks are averaged without normalization.

observations.observation: Are test predictions stored with an explicit float32 dtype?
observations.evidence: current_code.py: np.zeros((N_FOLD, len(smpl_sub), N_CLASSES)) omits dtype and thus defaults to float64.

observations.observation: Does the original prediction array use the fold ID as its storage index?
observations.evidence: current_code.py: test_preds_arr[fold_id] = test_pred, which assumes contiguous zero-based selected folds.

action_summary: Disable rank conversion, restoring probability averaging supported by the v17 versus v18 comparison. Add equal-weight original/horizontal-reflection test-time augmentation at the existing 448-pixel resolution to reduce view sensitivity while preserving all image content. Keep the five folds, checkpoint-compatible single-head architecture, Kaggle paths, and submission order. Use explicit numeric RGB normalization constants, float32 prediction storage, fold-position indexing, finite/probability output checks, and normalized tie-aware ranks for the optional disabled rank branch. No training or inference was run; any score improvement from augmentation remains unverified without data.
